Applying to Graduate Studies at McMaster University
Consult the department/program website and listing in the Graduate Calendar. A separate application for financial assistance is not required as all applicants are automatically considered for financial support. There is an application fee of $150. Applications will be considered at any time, but graduate programs commence in September, January, and May.
